facts.text: John was playing in a game that he described as awesome, and he expressed that it was an awesome feeling to be out there doing what he loves.

evidence.quote: That was from a game I just played. I was in it! It was awesome being out there, doing what I love. Such an awesome feeling.

facts.text: John stated that he was giving it his all every time he was on the court.

evidence.quote: Giving it my all every time I'm on the court.

facts.text: Tim expressed admiration for John's performance and encouraged him to keep going and not give up on his dreams.

evidence.quote: Wow! You look so into it in that pic – it must be so awesome playing at that level! Keep rockin' it!
Yeah, keep going! Don't give up on your dreams.
